concept: Socio - Religious Reform Movements in the 19th and 20th CE India
question: The Indian reformer Jyotirao Phule was primarily critical of which social evil of the Indian society?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Caste Discrimination**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jyotirao Phule**, a prominent Indian social reformer, was primarily concerned with the issue of **caste-based discrimination** in Indian society.
 
• He worked tirelessly to challenge the **Brahmanical dominance** and the oppression of lower-caste communities.
 
• Phule and his wife, **Savitribai Phule**, played a pivotal role in promoting **education for women** and **lower-caste individuals**.
 
• He founded the **Satyashodhak Samaj** (Society of Truth Seekers) in 1873 to fight against caste oppression and promote social equality.
 
• Jyotirao Phule strongly criticized the **Manusmriti** and other scriptures that justified caste discrimination.
 
• He referred to the lower-caste communities as **"Shudras" and "Ati-Shudras"** and advocated for their rights and dignity.
 
• Phule’s book, **"Gulamgiri" (Slavery)**, is a scathing critique of the caste system and its entrenched injustices.
 
• He is also credited with coining the term **"Dalit"** to describe the oppressed and marginalized communities in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Poverty**__

 __
 
• Poverty refers to the state of being unable to afford basic necessities such as **food, clothing, shelter**, and healthcare.
 
• While Jyotirao Phule did acknowledge the problems caused by poverty, his primary focus remained on **caste-based inequalities**.
 
 
 
• **Sati System**__
 __
 
• The Sati system was a practice where a **widow immolated herself** on her husband’s funeral pyre.
 
• This social evil was largely addressed by **Raja Ram Mohan Roy**, who worked to abolish it and succeeded with the passing of the **Sati Regulation Act, 1829**.
 
 
 
• **Child Marriage**__
 
 
• Child marriage involves the **marriage of minors**, often leading to severe consequences for the health and education of young girls.
 
• Reformers like **Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar** and **Bal Gangadhar Tilak** worked extensively to address this issue.
